What the edition says about itself, and where it came from.

The Mutopia Project's edition of Pachelbel's Canon, as the LilyPond text
files it is typeset from. The zip beside this note is untouched, as it was
downloaded on 2026-11-10. Nothing in the zip is used by the site as a file:
the site's script holds the edition's notes, read into it by tools kept
with the owner's working files (the line the three violins share, the first
violin's ending, how much of it each violin plays, and the bass's eight
notes). The bass is played an octave higher than written.

The piece's page on the Mutopia Project is not kept here; the SHA-256 of the
copy saved with the owner's working files is given so it can be checked.

Piece 2047
  Address:      https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=2047
  File:         https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/PachelbelJ/Canon_per_3_Violini_e_Basso/Canon_per_3_Violini_e_Basso-lys.zip
  Saved page:   SHA-256 2d29858f1e26cfd11e76e474e493c3deb789f0fdd5ee4330cbaeeeec5d330f87

What the edition's own header (header.ily, inside the zip) says:
  Title:        Canon per 3 Violini e Basso
  Composer:     Johann Pachelbel (1653-1706)
  Date:         1694
  Source:       IMSLP
  Instruments:  3 Violins, Cello
  Typeset:      2015, using LilyPond, by Michael Fischer v. Mollard
  License:      Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
  Mutopia ID:   Mutopia-2015/09/02-2047
The header also gives the maintainer's email address, as Mutopia publishes
it. The piece's page, read on 2026-11-10, says the same: the title,
Pachelbel, 1694, the source IMSLP, "Copyright: Creative Commons Attribution
4.0", the maintainer Michael Fischer v. Mollard and "Music ID Number:
Mutopia-2015/09/02-2047".

The license text is ../../sounds/licenses/CC-BY-4.0.txt.
